About Bekah

Christian. Wife. Mother.
Incorrigible homebody.

Bekah Overbey is a former English teacher who traded lesson plans for storylines — and hasn't looked back. She now spends her days chasing after her three wildlings and (generally unsuccessfully) trying to keep them out of mischief.

When she's not writing swoony romcoms with depth and heart, you can probably find her with a cup of coffee in hand, a blanket over her lap, and a to-be-read pile that's getting dangerously tall. Her books blend laugh-out-loud humor with characters who feel like real people navigating real things — and always a love story worth rooting for.
